name: smwgraphics-mega-man-bass-astro-man-space
title: Mega Man & Bass - Astro Man (Space)
description:
A space-ish background seen in some portions of Astro Man's Planetarium, from Mega Man & Bass. A great fit for space levels in general. A very light background which only uses 3A tiles, making it perfect to combine with other graphics.

Credit would be great, but is optional.
